opening.argument: The video directs viewers to open a Forsage account using a mobile phone and contact the promoter to begin. Its interface displays an invite link, a “Join Priority Leaders” button, team and partner statistics, and income-related figures. These are concrete recruitment features supporting the promotion of Forsage as an online-income platform, which the description calls the best platform in the world. Together, the account instructions and recruitment-linked presentation establish a scam promotion built around recruiting participants, rather than neutral commentary.

citations.quote: This is online income video. This platform name forsage. This a best platform in tje world.
